title: Rav Acha bar Ahavah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eruvin 98a, but Hyman proposes Rav Ada bar Ahavah there, as in Dikdukei Soferim. He likewise proposes Rav Ada for Rav Acha bar Ahavah in Yoma 44b. At the end of Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 1:1, Rabbi Chanina reports Rav Acha bar Achva; Hyman proposes the reading of the parallel in Shevuot 6b, Rav Ada bar Abba.

notes.text: The notice cites Dikdukei Soferim, not a specifically identified Vilna-edition emendation. Ahavah, Achva and Abba are the supplied patronym forms.
